content.comment_body: Hello, I'm seeking assistance because some features in [product_name] aren't working as expected. For example, when I try to use the function to edit input/output names from the edit menu, I get an error: java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException 'adapter type is not supported'. Based on what I've read and researched, this issue might be related to running Linux, specifically Debian 11.

Yes, my Java is up to date. Thank you for your suggestion – I previously used OpenJDK but, after your comment, switched to JDK to rule that out. Unfortunately, I'm still experiencing the same errors. Here are the Java versions I've tried: openjdk 11.0.13 2021-10-19 OpenJDK runtime environment (build 11.0.13+8-post-debian-1deb11u1) Java 17.0.1 2021-10-19 LTS Java(TM) SE Runtime Environment (build 17.0.1+12-LTS-39) Despite changing versions, the issue remains. Apologies for my delay in responding; I was pleasantly surprised by how quickly I received help.
I'm still unable to fix the issue and would greatly appreciate further support.
It might be helpful to review this topic: java.lang.UnsupportedOperationException: adapter type is not supported.

analysis.insight_summary: The user experiences a Java exception error when attempting to edit input/output names using [product_name] on Debian 11. The issue persists through various Java versions, suggesting a possible incompatibility with the Linux environment. Based on user research and comments, this seems to be a recurring issue for those running the software on Linux systems.
